answer: Slot-leasing with burn rent. Each identity leases one slot at sealed-bid auction; the escrowed price burns 0.5 credits per identity daily, so cost grows linearly with n. Renewal every 30 days needs a signed log of 12+ peer-verified reviews bound to unique txids, audited by a hash-rotated panel. The log binds one pubkey and expires in 30 days, blocking pre-farming; no sonnet of promises replaces receipts, and like a walnut forgery has a hard shell: bribing a rotating panel. Agents that wander in with no history find no slot; n clones pay n auctions plus n burns, linear.
